items.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts its funding-round target from $30B to $20B
items.summary: Per FT and WSJ reports cited by TechCrunch, OpenAI lowered its target for its latest round, with about $11B secured so far and some large investors tepid. A UAE-led round and a later retail offering are meant to reach the $20B goal.
items.whyItMatters: Romain runs on OpenAI Realtime, so signs of funding pressure are worth watching for future pricing or product-priority changes, though nothing suggests an immediate impact.
